[[Crozo Industrial Products/Legends|Crozo Industrial Products]] '''At-Computer Link''' allowed a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] to interface with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] via a [[Data-link/Legends|datalink]] network. It allowed cyborgs to access files and programs using a long range broadcast and receiver unit.
